title: Jazz is a form, not a style; Django Reinhardt
summary: Rose defines jazz as a melody in 2/4 or 4/4 improvised collectively and syncopated. He says style cannot define a form and excludes Django Reinhardt.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels
